// diagnostic E0904

Jet.UninferableTypeArgument

Can't infer a type argument

What

Can't infer a type argument

Why

The call's arguments and the code around it leave a type parameter undecided

Fix

Provide the type argument explicitly or add enough context to infer it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UninferableTypeArgument: Tests/UI/dispatch_hole_type_ambiguous.stderr.

Error: Jet.UninferableTypeArgument: Can't figure out what `T` should be here
  --> Tests/UI/dispatch_hole_type_ambiguous.jet:4:8
    |
  4 |     if missing(<>) {
    |        ^^^^^^^
 Why: Generic calls need enough context to pick a concrete type
 Fix: Pass the type argument explicitly, like `make<Int>()`, or give the value a typed head, like `p: Pair<Int>{ … }`
